declared: 2026-09-23, before any simulation of this family ran; the population verification gate runs first and no case is filtered by any outcome
family: 18 cases: base disruption probabilities x disruption losses x two frozen policies, around the v1 seasonal inventory instance

conventions.capacity_disruption: p_capacity = p_base + 0.02 when post-order stock equals capacity (the v1 additive convention, 0.06 -> 0.08)
conventions.disruption_loss: a disruption removes `loss` remaining units (floored at zero); the reward rule, including the one-category disruption penalty, is the v1 rule unchanged
conventions.policies: seasonal = v1 base-stock targets; plus_one = the same targets plus one unit, capped at capacity
conventions.reward_and_grid: v1 profit function, quantization to {0, 0.5, 1}, horizon 8, grid step 0.5, unchanged across the family

primary_analysis: tail-profit estimation error per case, and charged queries needed to reach the fixed absolute RMSE tolerances declared here: 0.02, 0.01, and 0.005 on the return scale, evaluated on the tested budget grid without extrapolation; separate prespecified comparisons of TIS and anchored TIS against occupancy, mean influence, rollouts, and both mixture controls
reporting: every case is reported, including cases favoring the baselines and cases with near-zero margins; no configuration is selected or dropped using method outcomes
